decision.rationale: Rejected and removed. Fusing RGB8 deinterleave, level shift, and RCT or nested-binary32-FMA ICT reduced the isolated input-stage physical dispatches from two to one and improved the RCT stage by 18.70-21.35% and the ICT stage by 52.59-53.27%. Exact native-oracle component bits, deterministic codestreams, independent decoding, lossless RGB8 output, and lossy PSNR were preserved. Neither product supported promotion under the fail-closed absolute-interval rule: RCT changed from 43.178660-43.383856 ms to 43.004971-43.371718 ms, and priority ICT changed from 194.879754-195.727981 ms to 194.967121-196.525571 ms while its point estimate regressed. A stage-local dispatch win does not justify the additional kernel and routing complexity without a decision-grade product improvement. The specialized kernel, launch route, selector, switch, and counters were removed; separate production stages remain, and the doc-hidden combined-input methods are two-dispatch compatibility wrappers.
